notes.title: 2 Years of Clicking Real Fast
notes.content:
Well, it's that time of year again. I've been fairly busy lately with school, work, and my latest (super secret) project, so haven't had much time to push a proper update for Click Real Fast.

I've been putting together some changes every now and then over the past few months, and feel it's time that I finally put out another big update. As you may have seen with the previous update, I added support for video backgrounds but didn't do much with it. Now, I finally put together new DLC pack with dynamic video backgrounds--fancy animated backgrounds with support for colour effects. While I could have make it free, I've gotta make money somehow ¯\_(ツ)_/¯. Maybe catch it when it's on sale if the extra 50¢ is too much. If you want something free to test out the new video background functionality, see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2215690/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url].

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3381744182

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805470/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3242480/

Regarding the aforementioned super-duper-extra-ultra secret project, stay tuned, it should be out very soon. I've been at it for nearly 20 months and now it's nearing completion.

Once again, a huge thanks to everybody who has supported Click Real Fast, and I look forward to at least another 2 years of clicking real fast with you.

Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays everybody.

notes.title: 1 Year of Click Real Fast
notes.content:
It has been 1 year since the release of Click Real Fast.

Despite being such a simplistic game, Click Real Fast has come a long way since the initial release — with your support and help, it has turned into the game it is now. With today marking 1 year since release, I've made some much needed changes, fixes, and added some new content. Now with 9 new achievements you can click even more, and with new audio effects you can listen to music like never before.

Thanks for a great year of Clicking Real Fast, let's make 2024 even better.

Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays,

notes.title: Click Real Fast - Update Notes - 2023-02-12
notes.content:
You may be thinking, "for a game so simple, how can there be so many things to change?" I'm wondering the same thing...

For this update, and all future updates, the game will backup all save files from the previous version. See guide below for instructions to restore backup files.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2932789648

With all these changes, you can now Click Real Fast, in a more refined manner.


[b]Changelog 2023-02-12:[/b]

[b]Game[/b]
- Added more click effects
- Added invite button (only for Steam lobby)
- Added points indicator (optional)
- Balanced cursor costs

[b]UI[/b]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]

notes.title: Click Real Fast Together
notes.content:
T'is the season to Click Real Fast. Did you happen to get a new mouse for Christmas? How about a keyboard or controller? Well, be sure to test its durability this holiday season by clicking real fast, with Click Real Fast.

Everything is better together... For the price of less-than-a-chocolate-bar, you can get the ultimate clicking game. Make sure to get a copy for all of your friends too, so you can prove that you don't click real slow.

Connect using Online multiplayer, or through Local Area Network (LAN). Play with 1 friend, or up to 100 [i](if you have that many).[/i]

notes.title: Click Real Fast - Workshop Update
notes.content:
The time has come... Click faster than you ever have... Break your mouse, not for the sake of anger, but as you pointlessly watch a number rise...

When wasting your time, you need to do it in style. Now, you can listen to your favourite music and look at the greatest pictures, with this update for Click Real Fast.

Not only can you add your own content, you can even download it from the largest library of free community created content, the Steam Workshop.

See instructions for uploading to the Steam Workshop in this guide:
